Suns 133Clippers 110

Goodwin hits six threes as the Suns' bench scores 81

Final · Tue, Nov 10 · Phoenix

Jordan Goodwin hit 6 of 7 threes, and the Suns’ bench scored 81.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · How it went

Won the first quarter 29–18

From the opening tip, the Suns won the first quarter 29–18 to lead 29–18.

2 of 5 · Who carried it

Goodwin: 18 points, 6 of 7 from three

18 points in 14 minutes, in his first game back from a calf injury.

3 of 5 · The Clippers’ side

From the Clippers’ side.

Lost the first quarter 18–29, the stretch that decided it.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it from three and off the bench

Bench points 81–62; assists 32–28. Phoenix shot 51 percent from three.

5 of 5 · What it meant

Suns 133, Clippers 110.

The Suns move to 5–6, 11th in the West. The Clippers fall to 2–8, 13th in the West.
